text: Why aren't you after Paul Warner?
I mean, he's the one who's behind all this.
He'd do anything to protect that threshold project, whatever the hell that is.
Gosh, I better go arrest him right away.
Oh, and just for the record, who gave you this information?
Get out. Get the hell out!
Fine, but I'll be back, you son of a bitch!
I'll be back to nail your ass to the wall!
